$comment: Shared provenance rule-engine conformance (orun-initiatives-v2 IS7, design §9 / IS-G). Byte-identical twin of orun internal/provenance/fixtures/provenance-conformance.json — `orun pr check` (Go) and the cloud orun/compliance evaluator (TS) replay these cases and must emit exactly these findings, in exactly this order, with exactly these texts. ASCII-only inputs by convention: the two engines' quoting/truncation agree on ASCII; keep it that way. Change this file only in lockstep with BOTH engines (the worklens pattern, applied twice).

cases.name: a clean pen leaves nothing to say

commitMessages:
feat: route the reads

Orun-Task: PAY-T14

cases.name: an off-grammar branch is the first finding
one task, one PR: the branch and the declared task must agree

findings.text: branch names PAY-T15 but the PR is for PAY-T14

cases.name: every commit carries the trailer, and for the SAME task

findings.text: commit "feat: no trailer here" lacks the Orun-Task trailer (orun githooks install adds it)
commit "fix: wrong task" is trailed for PAY-T15, not PAY-T14

cases.name: no manifest is a warning - pr open writes it

findings.text: no manifest block — `orun pr open` writes it; the compliance check will flag its absence

cases.name: a manifest must be coherent: known version, the same task, pins named when recorded

findings.text: the session recorded skill pins but the manifest names none

cases.name: a long first line truncates at 57 with an ellipsis

commitMessages: feat: this commit subject line just keeps going and going and going far past sixty characters

findings.text: commit "feat: this commit subject line just keeps going and going…" lacks the Orun-Task trailer (orun githooks install adds it)
